vb_textbox.text: Each color gnome is matched with the same color basket.  The baskets were either red or gold.  I noticed that for long periods a specific pair would always return a higher number of mushrooms, blue pointy hat + gold basket for example.  Although, this appears to change over time.  the Gnomes have either flat or pointy hats, so I tried to remember which combinations had high mushroom counts, and then favoured the higher yielding gnomes when they came up.  You need to experiment early game, but, it is fairly easy to work this out as the same 2 colors often appear in pairs.  When you notice that your high yielding combod start returning 11 or 0 then you will need to switch to the other color and re assess.
